# MrCheckpoint

> > MrCheckpoint provides DUI checkpoint alerts and connects drivers with criminal defense, DUI, and civil rights attorneys across major U.S. cities.

The platform serves as both a community awareness tool for road safety and a comprehensive attorney directory, featuring legal professionals in Houston, Los Angeles, Philadelphia, Washington DC, New Jersey, Arizona, California, and other jurisdictions. Notable firms include Grace Legal Group, Justice Team, and attorneys like Brian Zeiger.

## Key Topics

- DUI checkpoints
- Criminal defense attorneys
- DUI defense
- Civil rights law
- Attorney directory

- [Attorney Directory | MrCheckpoint Alerts, Community Awareness](https://mrcheckpoint.com/): Homepage: DUI checkpoint alerts & attorney directory for road safety
